name: Odunpazarı
vibe: The hill of restored Ottoman timber houses — Kurşunlu Mosque, glass workshops and the Odunpazarı Modern Museum

name: Arifiye
vibe: Hamamyolu's long park strip with the old thermal baths, the center's evening walk

name: İstiklal
vibe: The south bank of the Porsuk in the middle of town — riverside cafés, footbridges, the tourist boats

name: Hoşnudiye
vibe: Across the river on the Tepebaşı side — Barlar Sokağı and the center's late nights

name: Yenibağlar
vibe: Bağlar — the tram stop, Espark mall, student flats between the center and Anadolu University

name: Yeşiltepe
vibe: Anadolu University's Yunus Emre campus and the student streets around it

name: Meşelik
vibe: Osmangazi University's main campus on the south-western edge of town

name: İki Eylül
vibe: Eskişehir Technical University's campus out on the Sarıcakaya road, north of the city

name: Vişnelik
vibe: Apartment blocks off Atatürk Bulvarı, a walk from the old town and Kanlıkavak Parkı

name: Büyükdere
vibe: Residential blocks along Atatürk Bulvarı on the way out to the Osmangazi campus

name: Batıkent
vibe: Newer housing estates on the western side of Tepebaşı

name: Sazova
vibe: Sazova Park — the fairy-tale castle, the pirate ship, the Japanese garden, weekend picnics

name: Kentpark
vibe: The city park with a lake and a sand beach in the middle of Anatolia, with its own tram stop

name: Seyitgazi
vibe: The hilltop Seyyid Battal Gazi complex above a small town, under an hour south

name: Yazılıkaya
vibe: The Phrygian Midas Monument carved into the rock — the heart of the Phrygian Valley

name: Sivrihisar
vibe: The Seljuk Great Mosque with its forest of wooden columns, and Nasreddin Hoca's home district
